subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: What permanent host-path contract should Docker Gateway DooD sandbox mounts use for workspaceAccess and managed sandbox resources?
rationale: The remaining fix changes which host paths sandbox containers receive as bind sources, and the safe choice between automatic mount-table remapping, explicit operator mapping, or documented host-path parity is a sandbox/security and setup-product decision.

options.title: Define a security-reviewed mapping contract
options.body: Choose automatic mount-table remapping or an explicit setup/env mapping, validate mapped host sources before Docker receives them, cover workspace/skills/browser/custom binds, and require live DooD proof.

options.title: Require identical host paths only
options.body: Keep runtime behavior host-path-parity based and update Docker setup, docs, and doctor diagnostics to fail clearly when the Gateway container path cannot resolve on the host.

options.title: Land a narrow materialized-skills fix first
options.body: Allow the narrower related PR path to solve managed skills while keeping this broader workspaceAccess issue open for the full contract decision.

recommendation.title: Define a security-reviewed mapping contract
recommendation.body: Choose automatic mount-table remapping or an explicit setup/env mapping, validate mapped host sources before Docker receives them, cover workspace/skills/browser/custom binds, and require live DooD proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined signal from canonical triage plus recent current-main blame across sandbox bind, Docker docs, and setup paths.
